achievements.name: Story Battle
achievements.detail: Complete every mission required to win a story battle.

achievements.name: Powerful Foe
achievements.detail: Defeat a Powerful Foe that is leading monsters on the battlefield.

achievements.name: Sync Strike
achievements.detail: Fill the sync gauge, stand beside a ready ally, and launch a Sync Strike.

achievements.name: Zonai Device
achievements.detail: Fire a Zonai device in battle, such as a fan, rocket, time bomb, or elemental emitter.

achievements.name: Outpost
achievements.detail: Capture an enemy outpost during a battle so allied forces hold it.

achievements.name: Korok Seed
achievements.detail: Search a battlefield and pick up a Korok seed hidden there.

achievements.name: Field Chest
achievements.detail: Open a treasure chest found during a battle.

achievements.name: Giant Monster
achievements.detail: Defeat a giant monster in battle, such as a Hinox, a Lynel, or a Molduga.

achievements.name: Sage
achievements.detail: Clear a battle while playing as one of the sages who has joined the roster.

achievements.name: Sky Battle
achievements.detail: Win a battle that is fought in the air.

achievements.name: Zelda
achievements.detail: Clear a battle while controlling Zelda.
